name: Linlongopterus
isnote: Placed in Istiodactyliformes/Mimodactylidae by some analyses and near Ornithocheiriformes by others; unstable.
sum: Toothed pteranodontoid from the Jiufotang Formation of Jianchang, Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V15549 — Jiufotang Formation, Jianchang County, Liaoning.
material: Partial skull and mandible of a not fully grown individual.
biology: Cone-shaped, gently curved teeth suited to a fish diet.
author: Rodrigues et al. 2015

sources.text: Rodrigues, T.; Jiang, S.; Cheng, X.; Wang, X.; Kellner, A. W. A. (2015). A new toothed pteranodontoid (Pterosauria, Pterodactyloidea) from the Jiufotang Formation (Lower Cretaceous, Aptian) of China and comments on Liaoningopterus gui Wang and Zhou, 2003.
